stakeholders.need: A predictable onboarding promise and fewer cases waiting without an owner.
No design may bypass sanctions screening, high-risk approval, or exception review.
Remove duplicate entry, reduce handoffs, and make workload visible by role.
Expose case status and exception ownership before the customer asks for an update.
Submit information once, understand what is missing, and receive timely activation.
Compare realistic options and retain authority to accept assumptions and select the target design.
